flows.title: Share a chat
steps: Click Invite in the top-right of the chat header to open the Invite dialog.
Set who the chat is open to: Private or Only people with access, Everyone at your team, Anyone with the link, or Anyone on the web.
On a Plus, Business or Enterprise plan, invite individual team members and give each Can View or Can Edit.
Turn on View only when everyone at the team should see the chat without editing it.
A chat's own setting takes precedence over the workspace default, and the creator can change it at any time from the same dialog.

flows.title: Find a chat or a project
steps: Open the Projects tab in the v0 sidebar to see your Projects.
Press Cmd+K on a Mac, or Ctrl+K on Windows or Linux, to open the command palette and search across every chat and Vercel Project.
Results update as you type and are grouped by workspace; select one to go straight to it.
Shift+Cmd+F or Shift+Ctrl+F searches across files inside the code editor instead.

flows.title: Publish a chat as a template
steps: From the chat header, follow Project menu ... then Settings then Template.
Click Publish in the Publish as Template section.
Choose whether this is a new template or an update to an existing one.
Fill in the template details — a 1920x1080 preview image, a name, a description, a category, up to ten tags, and who it is visible to — then click Publish Template.
Published templates are listed in the v0 Templates gallery and reviewed by the v0 team.
